highlights.title: Organize your reading on a bookshelf
highlights.description: Books show their covers and collections become crates. Drag covers to organize them, follow the empty-collection guide, and see feedback when turning pages or opening collections.

highlights.title: One light and dark interface
highlights.description: Switch light, dark, or system appearance from the sidebar footer. Adjust font size and width in the reader toolbar; discussions use bubbles and numbered footnotes connect notes to the text.

highlights.title: Revisit WeRead highlights inside the app
highlights.description: Choose the embedded web reader in Settings. Locate highlights in a compact view without changing your account’s reading position, or expand it to keep reading.

highlights.title: Work through review suggestions
highlights.description: Scroll change previews independently and use previous, next, or discussion links to find pending suggestions. Citations show readable excerpts and return to the source.

highlights.title: New models and room to answer
highlights.description: Added presets including Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Carbon, with output limits sized per model so reasoning is less likely to consume the whole allowance before an answer.

highlights.title: More reliable EPUB reading and shortcuts
highlights.description: Old chapter documents are released after navigation, reducing loading work for image-heavy books. Highlight and question shortcuts now respond from the book body.
